name: Corrective RAG (CRAG)
executive_summary: Adds a retrieval evaluator (Correct/Incorrect/Ambiguous) that triggers web-search fallback or decomposition when retrieved documents are poor. Directly addresses RAG confabulation on empty or irrelevant retrieval.
description: CRAG evaluates each retrieved document against the query, labeling it Correct, Incorrect, or Ambiguous. If any document is Incorrect or all are Ambiguous, the system triggers a fallback. Only Correct documents are used for generation.
when_to_use: Production RAG systems where retrieval quality is variable.
Domains where stale or incorrect documents may be retrieved.
When a web-search fallback is available as a safety net.
when_not_to_use: When retrieval quality is consistently high and evaluation adds overhead.
When no fallback source is available.
Latency-critical applications where the evaluator adds unacceptable delay.
known_pitfalls: The evaluator itself can be wrong, leading to false positives or false negatives.
Web-search fallback may introduce new hallucination sources.
All-Ambiguous routing can be overly conservative.

variables.name: query
variables.example: What is the latest version of Python?

usage_templates.reproducibility_note: Multi-step pipeline: retrieval → evaluation → conditional fallback → generation. Evaluator prompt should be deterministic.
